# AI For DJs Global
> AI tools, playbooks, and training that help DJs and event promoters run their business — built in Hawaii, serving DJs worldwide.

## Topics
- [AI DJ Tools](https://aifordjsglobal.com): Automation and assistants for working DJs.
- [DJ Playbook](https://aifordjsglobal.com/playbook): Repeatable systems for bookings and marketing.
- [ChatGPT for DJs](https://aifordjsglobal.com): Prompts and workflows for music businesses.
- [DJ Business Automation](https://aifordjsglobal.com): Remote coaching and setup.


## Blog
- [Field Notes — AI for DJs Blog](https://aifordjsglobal.com/blog): AI DJ tools, workflows, hardware, stems, bookings, marketing, and business automation.
- [AI DJ Workflows for Pioneer, Denon, and Rane](https://aifordjsglobal.com/blog/ai-dj-workflows-pioneer-denon-rane): Practical AI preparation and performance workflows for rekordbox, Engine DJ, Serato, stems, and modern DJ hardware.
- [NAMM 2026 DJ Gear and AI](https://aifordjsglobal.com/blog/namm-2026): What new DJ hardware means for AI-assisted DJ workflows.
